messages:
hana: Heads-up: planning a soft-unpin of runtime 2.14 -> 2.13.8 for APAC cluster during our 01:00-03:00 UTC window. Reason: model-serving regressions with quant-v4b under high-concurrency.

matt: Is this full rollback or soft-unpin (canary first)?

hana: soft-unpin: canary 1% then manual to 10%. We want to exclude SDK 1.9 clients due to a known header mismatch.

deploy-bot: plan created: soft-unpin-runtime-2.14-apac | window 2024-07-20T01:00Z-03:00Z | canary 1% -> 10% @15m | predicate: exclude header x-sdk-version = 1.9.*

qa-liz: quick test in staging shows SDK 1.9 + runtime 2.14 -> small tokenization mismatch causing repeated retries. Repro: sdk 1.9 request -> retry loop.

matt: can we route by user-agent instead? some clients don't send x-sdk-version.

hana: telemetry: x-sdk-version present in ~58% apac traffic. Others report older UA strings; we'll treat them as unknown and exclude from canary as conservative.

ops: need rollback runbook attached. Also notify CS for customers in APAC on managed plans.

hana: rollback runbook: 1) set default runtime apac -> 2.13.8 via deploybot 2) scale canary to 0% 3) flush kvcache on affected pools 4) if error rate >0.5% for 10m escalate to oncall.

matt: I'll prepare a temporary deploy rule: `not header('x-sdk-version').matches('^1\.9\.') and header('region') == 'apac'` and push PR.

deploy-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood/deploy-rules/pull/510 | contains predicate and unit tests.

qa-liz: will add alert: streaming error rate >0.3% for unknown-sdk cohort after deploy.

hana: approved by ops. Proceed with soft-unpin under predicate. Will update pinlist + release notes after canary.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary start 2024-07-20T01:10Z | 1% traffic | excluded sdk 1.9 + unknown UA. Manual approval at 01:25Z to expand.

qa-liz: first 10m ok in canary. Errors within baseline. Waiting for manual expand window.
